ReturnsRefundsPage.title: Simple Returns, Clear Refunds
ReturnsRefundsPage.description: Review our return and refund policy, eligibility requirements and the steps required to submit a return request.

policy.title: Return Policy Overview
policy.description: We want you to shop with confidence. Please review the conditions below before requesting a return.

returnWindow.title: Return Window
returnWindow.description: Eligible products can be returned within 14 days of receiving your order.

productCondition.title: Product Condition
productCondition.description: Items must be unused, complete and returned in their original packaging.

proofOfPurchase.title: Proof of Purchase
proofOfPurchase.description: Your order number, invoice or valid purchase confirmation is required.

refundMethod.title: Refund Method
refundMethod.description: Approved refunds are returned through the original payment method where possible.

steps.title: How to Return an Item
steps.description: Follow these simple steps to submit your request and complete the return process.

contact.title: Contact Our Team
contact.description: Send your order number, product details and the reason for the return.

review.title: Request Review
review.description: Our support team reviews the request and confirms whether the item is eligible.

return.title: Return the Product
return.description: Prepare the item securely and follow the return instructions provided by our team.

refund.title: Receive Your Refund
refund.description: Once inspected and approved, the refund will be processed according to the policy.

note.title: Keep Your Packaging
note.description: Keeping the original box, accessories and invoice helps us process your request faster.

accepted.title: Items We Can Accept
accepted.unused: Products that are unused and remain in resalable condition.
accepted.packaging: Products returned with the original packaging and accessories.
accepted.receipt: Returns supported by an order number or proof of purchase.
accepted.damaged: Products received damaged, defective or different from the order.

excluded.title: Items We Cannot Accept
excluded.used: Products showing signs of use, damage or incorrect handling.
excluded.personalCare: Opened personal care, hygiene or beauty products.
excluded.clearance: Final-sale or clearance products marked as non-returnable.
excluded.missingParts: Products returned without accessories, parts or original packaging.

faq.title: Returns & Refunds FAQ
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about returns, refunds and exchanges.

time.question: How long does a refund take?
time.answer: After the returned product is received and approved, refunds are generally processed within 5 to 10 business days. Bank processing times may vary.

delivery.question: Can I return a product after 14 days?
delivery.answer: Returns submitted after the return window may not be accepted unless the product is covered by a valid warranty or arrived defective.

exchange.question: Can I exchange an item instead of receiving a refund?
exchange.answer: Exchanges may be available depending on product availability. Contact our support team to confirm the available options.

damaged.question: What should I do if my product arrives damaged?
damaged.answer: Contact us as soon as possible with your order number and clear photographs or videos of the product and packaging.

shipping.question: Who pays the return delivery cost?
shipping.answer: If the product is damaged, defective or incorrect, return delivery is handled according to our support instructions. Other returns may include a return delivery charge.

cta.title: Need Help With a Return?
cta.description: Contact our support team with your order number and product details, or track your order before submitting a request.
